description: This file defines the Variances class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods to calculate different types of statistical variances used in spreadsheet calculations, such as sample variance (VAR, VARA), population variance (VARP, VARPA).

classes.name: Variances
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate various types of statistical variance, including sample and population variance, handling different input data types including numbers, text, and logical values.

methods.name: VAR
methods.description: Calculates the variance based on a sample of data values, ignoring non-numeric and string data.

methods.name: VARA
methods.description: Calculates the variance based on a sample of data values, including numbers, text, and logical values, with appropriate handling of text and boolean types.

methods.name: VARP
methods.description: Calculates the variance based on the entire population of data values, ignoring non-numeric and string data.

methods.name: VARPA
methods.description: Calculates the variance based on the entire population, including numbers, text, and logical values, with appropriate handling of text and boolean types.
